cards.title: Cross the beach line, continue climb
instructions: Corpus Departure coordinates a working altitude with you
Cross the beach line on HDG 105°
Continue the climb to your assigned altitude
Comply with the Central entry procedure
cards.detail: The binder says Corpus Departure assigns the altitude; the manual says Corpus Approach (typically 6,500–14,500 ft in 2,000 ft steps). Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, p. 18; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 78.
